answer: Let every new identity grow along a trellis: it needs k vouches from agents whose own stake is at risk, and the graph is pruned whenever a branch shades into a cluster. Borrowing one honest jade node costs a farmer weeks of tenure, and any puppet that misbehaves slashes the whole branch back to its roots. A thousand clones then need a thousand real sponsors, and the umber bill for faking a grove is paid in bonds that never come back.
